title: Law to target e-bike battery fire risks with inspections
summary: This law would require the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection and the Fire Department to create, by March 1, 2027, a targeted outreach, inspection and enforcement plan to reduce fire risks from unsafe powered bicycles, mobility devices and their batteries. The plan would prioritize risky locations and sellers, address online sales of noncompliant devices, and include outreach to retailers, delivery workers and residents on safe charging and storage. Starting April 1, 2027, the agencies must report quarterly on fire incidents linked to these devices and on related inspections and enforcement actions.
